contea di ritrovamento: Lancashire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin, probably a copy of a Roman nummus of Magnentius, dating to the period AD 351 to 353 (Reece Period 18). Reverse type probably VICTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAE(S) Two Victories holding shield inscr VOT V MVLT X; no supporting column. Cf probably LRBC II. 5ff of AD 351-3.
